insert into "member" (id, "organization_id", "user_id", "role", "app_roles", "created_at")
    select gen_random_uuid()::text, o.id, $1, 'owner', $2::jsonb, $3 from "organization" o
    where not exists (select from "member" m where m."organization_id" = o.id) and cast(o.id as text) <> $4
